mapper.select: SELECT b_idx, b_name, b_address, b_description, b_latitude, b_altitude, b_phone, b_file, b_active FROM branch WHERE b_active = 1

SELECT b_idx, b_name, b_address, b_description, b_latitude, b_altitude, b_phone, b_file, b_active FROM branch WHERE b_active = 1 AND b_latitude BETWEEN #{swLat} AND #{neLat} AND b_altitude BETWEEN #{swLng} AND #{neLng}
SELECT b_idx, b_name, b_address, b_description, b_latitude, b_altitude, b_phone, b_file, b_active FROM branch WHERE b_idx = #{brnIdx}

SELECT b_idx, b_name, b_address, b_description, b_latitude, b_altitude, b_phone, b_file, b_active, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b_latitude)) * cos(radians(b_altitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b_latitude)))) AS distance FROM branch WHERE b_active = 1 HAVING distance < 5 ORDER BY distance
